newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma still a buy.

text.p: -- Flemings Research said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating for Brazilian brewery Brahma.

-- It said Brahma posted respectable 1996 earnings despite a small growth of three percent in its beer volumes in Brazil and a rise of 41 percent in depreciation due to the startup of its new mega-plant in Rio de Janeiro.

-- "Unlike most of its peers, Brahma has the scope to increase its market share as it controls under 50 percent of the domestic market, competes against a declining domestic counterpart, and faces limited competition from foreign brewers over the next three years," it said.
-- It added that Brahma is located in one of the fastest growing beer markets in Latin America. Flemings estimates Brazil's beer market will grow at a compound rate of seven percent through 2000.
-- Brahma preferred shares closed at 740 reais Wednesday.
